title: OpenCode HTTP Minimal Async Prompt Canary
summary: The FP-MCP-247 minimal OpenCode HTTP async prompt canary ran successfully with cleanup enabled. It created one titled OpenCode session, submitted the tiny prompt through /session/{id}/prompt_async, read messages before and after, polled /session/status, observed the exact assistant text OPENCODE_HTTP_CANARY_OK, and deleted only the created canary session. The canary returned sessionCreated=true, promptAsyncSubmitted=true, promptAsyncHttpStatus=204, messagesAfterHttpStatus=200, messagesAfterCount=2, assistantMessageCountAfter=1, assistantTextObserved=true, canaryTextObserved=true, boundedAssistantTextExcerpt=OPENCODE_HTTP_CANARY_OK, cleanupAttempted=true, sessionDeleted=true, and deleteHttpStatus=200. It also confirmed waitEndpointCalled=false, runnerStartEndpointContacted=false, and opencodeStarted=false. The status timeline briefly reported sessionStatusType=busy on attempts 1 and 2, then returned null rather than idle; therefore completion was observed from /session/{id}/message contents, not from /session/status reaching idle.
caveats: This was the first canary that submitted an OpenCode model prompt, but the prompt was deliberately tiny and bounded: Return exactly: OPENCODE_HTTP_CANARY_OK.
The tool did not call /api/session/{id}/wait or any wait endpoint, so wait semantics remain unverified.
The status timeline observed busy briefly, but did not observe idle; /session/status should not yet be used as the sole completion source.
The created canary session was deleted after observation; retained evidence is the ForgePilot checkpoint and structured record, not the OpenCode session itself.
boundaries: A tiny OpenCode prompt was submitted via /session/{id}/prompt_async.
No OpenCode wait endpoint was called.
No ForgePilot runner start endpoint was contacted.
No OpenCode process was started by this canary.
No execution approval was created, consumed, or authorized.
No local execution clearance was created.
Only the canary-created session was deleted.
No file-editing task was requested from the model.
